8d89a3956128098f41e46c00e419b365316bef50.summary: Administrator guidance on managing Outlook cached mode and OST offline file sizes. It covers OST size limits by Outlook version, the cached mode slider, and Group Policy and registry settings, and explains when size management is needed. It describes no threat actors, malware, vulnerabilities or incidents, so it is not a threat report.

8d1db7e991c10f3b8b61b72e7c5c31d1ea5fc973.summary: This is a PricewaterhouseCoopers marketing page describing its cyber threat intelligence offerings: technical and regional reporting, indicator-of-compromise data feeds, a research portal, and access to analysts. It names no specific threat, actor, malware, vulnerability, or incident, so it is not a threat report.

8dcd6158f82898310af73d9fbeae8e626dbfdb7b.summary: Visa security alert from August 2016 on a compromise of Oracle MICROS point-of-sale and hospitality systems. Oracle said it detected malicious code in certain legacy MICROS systems on 8 August 2016 and was investigating; as of 12 August 2016 it had not published the cause. Visa links the activity to two cybercrime threats, Carbanak and MalumPOS, and lists indicators of compromise and mitigation steps for MICROS customers.
